notes.title: Beta is out!
notes.content:
We've released the beta version of RV Kingdom 0x0297. The playtest has started.

[b]How to participate?[/b]
You can apply for participation on the Steam store page. Then, we will choose some limited number of players to be beta testers.

[b]What will beta testers be able to do?[/b]
They will get access to the beta version of the game that we will periodically update. 
The beta now includes:
[list]
[*]2 classes to play as (hero and monk)
[*]115 mobs including 10 bosses
[*]About 60 NPC in different locations
[*]1 game ending
[/list]

[b]For beta testers[/b]
If you find any bug or localization issue in the game, please let us now [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2520130/discussions/0/4362373279647384783/]here[/url].

notes.title: The Beta Test Announcement
notes.content:
The main story of RV Kingdom 0x0297 is almost complete which means the beta test is coming soon. We  will choose few testers to improve the gameplay experience. 

[b]What's next?[/b]
During the beta, we will update the game adding new features. We still have many things we want to add to the game which includes: 
1.Many characters the player will be able to play as
2.New side quests including some lore-rich storylines
3.New locations that player will be able to explore
4.Various game endings
5.Bug fix and gameplay improvements based on the testers' feedback

We will try to make the game as good as we can and we hope you will enjoy it. If you like RV Kingdom, add it to your wishlist and follow the news.

notes.title: Some news about the development
notes.content:
We got some progress making the game and now we'd like to tell more about the game's current state and our future plans. 

[b]Numbers[/b]
We've been making this game for over 2 years (since May 2021).
For now a significant part of the game is done, though it is still in the alpha version.
[olist]
[*] [b]100%[/b] of the game core mechanics are already done including combat system, NPC interaction, global map exploration and much more.
[*] [b]45[/b] of the 78 planned combat abilities are done and are used in the game.
[*] There are currently [b]75 [/b] different creatures to see on the battlefield both as your ally or enemy and that number will keep growing.
[*] There are about [b]30[/b] NPCs to talk to and [b]17[/b] quests to complete.
[*] [b]2 of 15[/b] game classes are completely done.
[/olist]

[b]When is the beta version?[/b]
Before the beta version we have to complete 3 more story lines for the game including the final battle and make some minor changes to make our game more friendly to new players.

[b]What will the beta look like?[/b]
Now we are planning to make closed beta test among several game testers to improve the feedback we get from the community. During the beta, we will be adding more side quests, new classes, translations in different languages and much more. When this is done, we will release the game.

[b]About the game's name[/b]
'RV' is a franchise name that means the Real Virtuality which is the universe where the events take place. 'Kingdom' is a game series name within the RV universe. It marks some general idea. '0x0297' is the year in hexadecimal number system when the game starts. Such naming system would be useful to organize future games within one franchise.

[b]About us[/b]
We are a small team of game developers. Before this game we made RV City - a city building simulator in the same universe as RV Kingdom 0x0297. It was our first completed game. It hasn't been released in Steam since it was non-commercial project and we were making it just for fun.
